## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-c) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `9639ec57` · 2026-11-21T14:47Z

**Card:** `Fixes #36070` (epic #36062 phase 1). All four "要做的" items and every acceptance line are delivered here, so `Fixes` is right. Claim 7063168425; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. No `packages/spec/src/**` or `docs/adr/**` in the diff, so this is not a contract face; the requesting thread runs its declared L2 on this head.

**Gates:** CI 52 success · 10 skipped · 0 failed on `9639ec57`; mergeable clean; `l1-face` CLEAN (changesets cover `plugin-detail`, `fields`, `i18n`, `app-shell`).

**Code read (26 files):**
- `ThreadedReplies`: `focusReplyOnOpen` (default `false`) tracks each false→true opening of the input. It expands the replies during that render, and an effect focuses the input once it is drawn. The timeline's `showReplyInput={replyOpen}` starts `false`, so nothing takes focus on mount; a second open focuses again. The default-off case has a CONTROL test.
- `CommentAuthorAvatar`: the `Avatar`/`AvatarFallback` pair with `getPersonInitials` from `@object-ui/fields`, which `plugin-detail` already depends on (no new edge, no cycle). Comments go from the 14 px icon cell to a 20 px cell; replies go from 24 px to 20 px. Both are 20, as the card asks.
- `RichTextCommentInput` + `textareaCaret.ts`: the mirror-div caret measure. The textarea's offset parent is the new `relative` editor box, so `offsetTop + caret.top - scrollTop` is in box coordinates. Left is clamped into `[0, box width − 224]`. The menu goes above only when the space below is short of 164 px and the space above is larger. Where layout cannot be measured, it falls back to the old `left-2 bottom-full`. This is the well-known mirror technique, written fresh here; nothing reads as copied from Twenty.
- `RecordDetailView.handleDeleteComment`: `toast.success` only after the server delete and the local removal; a refused delete keeps its error toast. Reply deletes go through the same handler and get the same toast, which is fine.
- `detail.commentDeleted` is in all eleven packs (spot-read zh-Hans, ja, ar: real text). The docs fix of `showReplyInput`'s default to `true` matches the code (`showReplyInput = true`).

**The re-red, checked as asked:** `8a8e7076` and `9639ec57` touch only test files. The first commit changes three reply pins in `…authoredActivityThreading-12249` and `…replyCountOnRead-12144`. These pins clicked the count toggle to expand, but `rootRowOf` presses Reply first, which now already expands; a second click would fold the replies away. Each pin keeps its content assertion (the child or new reply is on screen under its parent), and the 12144 pin adds that the toggle still folds them away. The pins are not weakened. The second commit adds `commentDeleted` to that test's `Pack` type. Product code is the same as at `3f86e683`.

**Tests:** new `commentSmallFixes-36070` has 10 cases: focus and expand, a default-off control, Latin and CJK initials on comment and reply, and the menu below, above, clamped and on fallback. The delete pin asserts the success toast, and asserts no toast on Cancel or a refused delete.

**Evidence:** before and after screenshots, light and dark, of Reply-then-type, Reply on a collapsed thread, initials and delete. The mention menu is light only. `document.activeElement` read: before `BUTTON Reply`, after `INPUT Reply…`. The images were removed again in `4752bb30`, so none reach main.

**Owed before landing (evidence only, no code):** there is no 375-wide reading. Comments draw on the phone record page too, so the new avatar and the mention menu reach phones. One 375 screenshot of a comment with its reply open, and one of the `@` menu at 375, close this. I expect both to pass: the menu is clamped to the box width.

Verdict: **ACCEPT** at `9639ec57`, with the 375 evidence owed. A new head gets a delta read.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `9639ec57c62e6c8d8b9bc65378ad0a5f21fa9e8b`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36070 (body and both comments: the triage and the seat's `Claim:`), epic #36062 and sibling #36075 (bodies only), the PR #36105 body and file list, the net diff `main...9639ec57c` (26 files; the evidence screenshots added in `7e6998c0` are removed in `4752bb30` and are not in the net diff), and the 62 check-runs on the head: every one is `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending. That includes Type Check UI, Lint UI / ESLint, Test UI 1-16/16, Build & E2E UI, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the PR-body guards.

### ① Derived judgments

No accept-set change. Nothing under `packages/spec`, no metadata key, value or type is involved, and no governed surface is touched. `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct. The public-surface changes the diff implies:

- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: adds `CommentAuthorAvatar` (value) and `CommentAuthorAvatarProps` (type), both exported from `src/index.tsx`. This is additive and **right**. The props (`name`, optional `avatarUrl`, optional `className`) are a minimal, reusable shape for #36075, which the card and epic both say must carry these pieces over.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: adds the optional prop `ThreadedRepliesProps.focusReplyOnOpen` (default `false`). This is additive and **right**. With the default `false`, existing hosts that always show the input (`showReplyInput` defaults to `true`) keep their mount-time focus behaviour, and the CONTROL test in `commentSmallFixes-36070.test.tsx` pins that. Only `RecordActivityTimeline` passes it, behind its own Reply toggle.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: `textareaCaret.ts` / `getTextareaCaretCoordinates` stays internal. It is not exported from the package entry. **Right**: the helper is not made part of the public surface.
- `@object-ui/fields`: adds the root export `getPersonInitials(name: string): string`. The function already exists in `widgets/personDisplay.ts` and is the one used by `PersonRow`, `SelectionTray` and the `LookupField` chips. This is additive and **right**: it is how item 2 of the card ("same set as the person chips") is met without a second copy. Nothing on `main` exports a symbol with this name, so the new export collides with nothing.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: adds the key `detail.commentDeleted` to all eleven packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans 评论已删除, zh-Hant). Each pack has a real translation, not an English copy. This is additive and **right**. The card's 「评论已删除」 is matched exactly in zh-Hans.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `handleDeleteComment` now calls `toast.success` after the server delete resolves. Cancel and refused-delete paths are unchanged, and both assert that no success toast appears. This is a behaviour change only, with no declaration change: **right**.
- The docs table fix (`showReplyInput` default `false` changed to `true` in `plugin-detail.mdx`) corrects the docs to match the code (`showReplyInput = true`). **Right**: it changes nothing in meaning.

Nothing is removed or renamed, and no declared meaning or default changes. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is accurate.

### ② Semver level

The changeset `.changeset/36070-comment-small-fixes.md` sets `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. Those are exactly the four published packages the diff moves; `content/docs` and tests publish nothing. Under AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3), a `Metadata-protocol: none` change takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening also ships `patch`, so the level is **right**.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body. Both lines match the seat's `Claim:` on the card and the diff as measured above. Check Changeset is `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags / `open_questions`:** none raised in the PR body or on the card. The card's 「没有核对的」 item ("where real keyboard typing lands after Reply cannot be tested by automation") is answered by the PR's browser evidence. That evidence reads `document.activeElement` after Reply (before: `BUTTON Reply`; after: `INPUT Reply…`) and confirms that typed text lands in the reply input. The two coordinator additions (20 px avatar; the menu flips above near the bottom) are implemented as written. Every acceptance line has a test or evidence. The before/after screenshots the card asks for are attached.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5):** no finding. The diff adds no data read, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The delete path's single `dataSource.delete` call and its local list update are unchanged. Only a toast is added.
- **Finding: should-fix (not part of the declaration contract; the dev did not flag it).** The PR leaves `STREAM_ICON_CELL` dead in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx:197`. Its jsdoc still says "A comment's icon cell", but the comment row now draws `COMMENT_AVATAR_CELL` (`w-5`, 20 px) instead. The only reader left is the regex at `ui/e2e/narrow-drawer-time-34614.spec.ts:73` (`feedIcon: grab(FEED, /const STREAM_ICON_CELL =.../, ['shrink-0','w-3.5'])`). That geometry pin says it reads the comment row's real icon cell out of the source, so its 380 px fixture now draws a 14 px cell where the real row draws 20 px. Its claim is now false, and it keeps a dead constant alive. The dead constant also adds a new `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` warning, although the PR body says the touched files are "clean of new warnings". The rule is at `warn`, so CI stays green. Fix: point the spec's `feedIcon` grab at `COMMENT_AVATAR_CELL` with tokens `['shrink-0','w-5']`, then delete `STREAM_ICON_CELL`. Recommended before merge.
- **Nit:** in `textareaCaret.ts`, when `line-height` computes to `normal`, the height falls back to `marker.offsetHeight`. The marker holds the whole rest of the text, so that height can span several lines. The textarea's classes (`text-sm` / `leading-5`) always set a line-height, so this branch is not reached today.
- **Nit:** in `RichTextCommentInput`, the rows of the mention candidate list still draw their own `charAt(0)` initials disc rather than `getPersonInitials`. The card leaves candidates out of scope, so this can become a follow-up item.
